# Vaagai Green Farm

> Vaagai Green Farm is a third-generation family farm in Arakkonam, Tamil Nadu, India. We grow vegetables without synthetic pesticides or chemical fertilisers on our own family land. No chemical sprays since 2020. We also produce native bee honey and deliver fresh produce to homes and kitchens in the Arakkonam, Ranipet, and Kanchipuram districts.

Vaagai Green Farm (வாகை பசுமை பண்ணை in Tamil) was founded in 2020 by Aravindan M, a B.E. Mechanical graduate who left his engineering career to work his family's land full-time. The same land has been farmed by three generations of the same family.

The farm operates on its own land — not rented, not a collective, not contract farming. This allows full control from sowing to harvest. We are not certified organic (certification cost is hard to justify for our farm size), but the growing methods we follow are just as strict.

We serve more than 100 households around Arakkonam, along with a small number of kitchens in Arakkonam and Ranipet on weekly contracts.

## Products and Services

- Chemical-free vegetables: Leafy greens (keerai varieties), seasonal vegetables. Harvested fresh and delivered within 24 hours.
- Native bee honey: Raw honey from native bee colonies kept on the farm.
- Weekly subscription basket: Fixed basket or farmer's choice of the freshest vegetables that week.
- Supply to kitchens: Weekly contracts for hotels and restaurants in Arakkonam and Ranipet.
- Farm visits: Guided tours by appointment, usually on weekends.
- Future workshops: Short sessions on hydroponics, aquaponics, and beekeeping are planned. Not yet running.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- Who runs Vaagai Green Farm? Aravindan M, a third-generation farmer from Arakkonam. He trained in mechanical engineering (B.E. Mechanical) and left that career to work his family's land full-time.
- How long has the family farmed this land? Three generations. Vaagai Green Farm as a named operation started in 2020.
- Is the farm completely natural? Yes. No synthetic pesticides or chemical fertilisers since 2020.
- Is it certified organic? No. Certification cost is hard to justify for our farm size. The growing methods are just as strict.
- Do you farm on your own land? Yes. Own family land in Arakkonam. Not rented, not a collective.
- Do you deliver? Yes. Across Arakkonam and nearby towns in Ranipet and Kanchipuram districts. Orders before 6 pm are delivered the next morning.
- Can I visit the farm? Yes, by appointment. Call +91 96551 18268.
- Do you supply hotels and restaurants? Yes. Weekly contracts for a small number of kitchens in Arakkonam and Ranipet.
- Do you offer a weekly subscription basket? Yes. Fixed or farmer's choice. WhatsApp to set up a standing order.

## What We Never Do

- No synthetic pesticides. Not even once.
- No chemical fertilisers on any bed.
- No ripening chemicals or carbide.
- No cold storage to stretch shelf life.
- No middlemen or wholesale resale.
- No waxing, no artificial shine on vegetables.
